Chiron trine the South Node can make a familiar coping skill, helping role, or hard-earned sensitivity feel natural and useful. You may know how to notice what other people miss because you learned from experience. Keep the wisdom. Check that you are not staying in the wounded role simply because you became exceptionally good at surviving from there.
